[0] A leaker from China with a reliable track record has posted several images online claiming to be circuit diagrams of the next-generation iPhone 18 Pro models.

[1] The images suggest the next-generation A20 Pro chip may feature 7 GPU cores—one more than the previous generation—and adopt a faster memory interface…

[2] The images posted by Weibo user "炸白米飯" are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather schematic diagrams showing the chip's position on the underlying circuit board. Based on this, the leaker infers the performance and architecture of the new chip, drawing two main conclusions and discussing possible areas of improvement.

[3] First, the circuit diagram shows six CPU cores, the same configuration as last year's model: two high-performance cores plus four energy-efficient cores. However, the energy-efficient cores appear to be equipped with larger cache memory.

[4] From the limited information provided by the solder-point schematic, it is difficult to deduce the number of GPU cores—six, seven, or eight are all possible. Nevertheless, the leaker ultimately considers seven cores to be the most likely.

[5] Fix Focus Digital previously pointed out that the A20 Pro chip will deliver 18% better performance than its predecessor while improving power efficiency by 30%.

[6] 9to5Mac's Take

[7] The Weibo account does have some credibility, but this kind of indirect inference is somewhat like "black magic." Although the conclusions sound reasonable, they should not be taken as confirmed information, only as well-founded speculation.
